critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar.jsx (186 lines): Clean sub-component split — BrandHeader, CreditsWidget, BuyCreditsCta, NavItem, NavList, LicenseBadge — all single-responsibility. NAV_ITEMS array is the single source of truth for nav rendering + testids. useEffect on location.pathname correctly closes the mobile drawer on route change. drawerCls ternary swap between -translate-x-full and translate-x-0 is fine; lg:translate-x-0 override for desktop is correct.

DownloadCliButton.jsx (149 lines): CliTrigger switches between primary/compact via variant prop — both variants share the same data-testid='cli-download-trigger' which is correct (only one is rendered at a time per instance). CliPopover uses a fixed inset-0 click-outside catcher — good pattern. Clipboard.writeText error is logged only in dev — clean.

DownloadDesktopButton.jsx (139 lines): Same pattern as CLI button — DesktopTrigger variant switch, DesktopPopover with inset-0 backdrop, BuildRow row component. Icons are attached to BUILDS entries and pulled via build.icon — clean data-driven rendering.

GetDesktopHeroCard.jsx (133 lines): dismissed state defaults to true and flips to false only after successful localStorage read — this prevents a flash of the card for users who already dismissed it. Nice defensive pattern. HeroInfo + HeroActions + ScanLineOverlay split is clean. Both .dmg / .AppImage anchors call onDismiss on click, which is consistent with the Windows path.

server.py emergent_session_exchange (10 lines) + 3 helpers (_fetch_emergent_profile / _upsert_google_user / _persist_emergent_session): Nice separation of concerns — HTTP fetch, DB upsert, and cookie/session persistence are each isolated. _fetch_emergent_profile correctly raises 401 on upstream non-200 (verified via curl-equivalent pytest). _upsert_google_user preserves the existing user_id on refresh and only overwrites name/picture — no unintended role/plan/credits reset on re-auth. _persist_emergent_session writes samesite=none;secure;httponly cookie consistent with the other auth cookies.

OBSERVATION (non-blocking): DesktopPopover has no Escape-to-close handler — only backdrop click + trigger toggle. Same for CliPopover. Minor UX polish opportunity but not a regression from this iteration.
